Send SMS.description: Sends a single SMS to a phone number through the project's default route.

Send Appointment Reminder.description: Sends a personalised reminder from a specific phone/route and tracks delivery.

Send Message to Contact.description: Sends a message to an existing Telerivet contact, filling in contact variables.

Send Voice Call.description: Places a text-to-speech call, e.g. for low-literacy recipients.
